clock.clockworkdiver.pocket_watch.desc: A golden pocket watch that has kept its owner's time for many years. A precise wheel train fills its little case.
clock.clockworkdiver.cuckoo.desc: A carved wooden cuckoo clock shaped like a forest cabin. A little bird pops out on the hour.
clock.clockworkdiver.astronomical.desc: A deep blue dial tracking the sun, the moon and the zodiac. Layers of gears recreate the dance of the stars.
clock.clockworkdiver.birdcage.desc: A mysterious clock where a clockwork songbird sings under a glass dome.
clock.clockworkdiver.steam_tower.desc: An iron tower clock driven by steam. Its gauges and pipes rumble like the heart of the city.
clock.clockworkdiver.orrery.desc: A great clock where planets circle the sun. One of the most intricate timepieces in the city.
defect.clockworkdiver.rust.desc: Rust has seized a gear. Dive in and smash every rust cluster with your wrench. Watch out for the rust mites crawling out.
defect.clockworkdiver.teeth.desc: Cog gremlins stole the teeth. Defeat the glowing gremlins, take the teeth back and fit them into the sockets.
defect.clockworkdiver.screw.desc: A giant screw came loose. Climb its thread like a spiral stair and turn the slot in its head on the beat.
defect.clockworkdiver.spring.desc: The spring has run down. Turn the central crank with your wrench to wind it. Enemies near the crank unwind it.
defect.clockworkdiver.nest.desc: A Time Eater, a beast that devours time, nests here. Only Just Tick blows can crack its shell.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.offer.0: Ah, you must be the new clockmaker. I'm Gregory - the oldest customer in this town.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.offer.1: My late wife gave me this pocket watch. One morning it simply stopped... Something inside seems to have rusted.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.wait: Hm, time still stands still. No need to hurry. ...Well, perhaps hurry a little.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.deliver: Oh... that sound in your hands! Is it fixed?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.thanks.0: Tick, tock... ah, that's the sound. It reminds me of the nights I danced with my wife.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.gregory.thanks.1: Splendid work. The clocks of this town will come to rely on you, I'm sure.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.offer.0: You're the famous 'diving clockmaker'! I'm Ada, an inventor.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.offer.1: My masterpiece won't behave. Sparks flew out of the gears and then - snap - it stopped.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.wait: How is it going? By my calculations you can definitely fix it!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.deliver: That look on your face... is it fixed already?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.thanks.0: Perfect! It sounds even clearer than before. You must tell me what you did in there.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.ada.thanks.1: As thanks, you'll be the first to see my next invention!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.offer.0: Hey, clockmaker! Name's Bolt, steam engineer.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.offer.1: The station clock went haywire. The train timetable is a mess and the whole town is in an uproar!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.wait: The trains are waiting, mate! ...Not that I doubt your skills.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.deliver: Whoa, that heartbeat... did you fix it?!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.thanks.0: Ha! What a sound! Now the whistles will blow right on time.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.bolt.thanks.1: I'll let you ride in the locomotive cab sometime. That's a promise!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.offer.0: Hello! I'm Lily, I sell flowers. Could you look at this one for me?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.offer.1: It's the precious clock that wakes me every morning, but it's been silent for three days...
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.wait: Is it still feeling poorly...? Take your time, please.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.deliver: Oh! I think I just heard it tick!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.thanks.0: It's running again! Thank you, thank you so much!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.lily.thanks.1: I'll bring you the prettiest flowers from my stall!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.offer.0: Forgive the late visit. I am Celes, an astronomer.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.offer.1: This clock that keeps the motion of the stars has begun to drift. A few seconds now become a whole star's width in a century.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.wait: The stars will not wait. Yet I should not rush your work either.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.deliver: ...The ticking matches the stars again. Surely not already?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.thanks.0: Wonderful. Tonight's observations will be beautiful.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.celes.thanks.1: May I name a newly found little star after you?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.offer.0: Tonight I come as a customer. My name matters little... they call me the Phantom Thief.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.offer.1: Something nests inside this clock I stole... I mean, acquired. It is beyond my talents.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.wait: I shall not rush you. But I am not the only one who covets this clock.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.deliver: Oh? You drove out the 'thing' inside the clock?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.thanks.0: Superb, master clockmaker. Your hands are worth more than any jewel.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.phantom.thanks.1: Your fee is here, as promised. ...Let us hope we never meet as enemies.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.offer.clock: Please repair this %1$s. It seems to have %2$s faulty part(s). I'll pay %3$s brass coins.
dialogue.clockworkdiver.offer.tutorial: (Tutorial) Press 'Accept' to take the clock. Then press the 'Repair Bench' button to go to the bench and inspect the clock with the mysterious spectacles.
objective.clockworkdiver.start: Use the Workshop Key to go to your clock repair workshop
objective.clockworkdiver.wait: Wait for a customer to arrive...
objective.clockworkdiver.find: At the repair bench, move the spectacle lens to find faulty parts (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.choose: At the repair bench, pick a faulty part and dive into the clock (repaired %s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.deliver: Give the repaired clock back to the customer
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.rust: Smash the rust clusters with your wrench (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.teeth: Take the teeth back from the glowing gremlins and fit them into the sockets (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.screw: Stand on the screw head and turn it on the beat (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.spring: Turn the crank to wind the spring (%s%%)
hint.clockworkdiver.workshop.0: This is your clock repair workshop. Customers will bring their clocks here.
hint.clockworkdiver.workshop.1: When a customer arrives, right click them across the counter to talk.
hint.clockworkdiver.bench.0: You got the clock! Press the 'Repair Bench' button on screen to go to the bench.
hint.clockworkdiver.bench.1: To go back later, right click the clock or right click the repair bench itself.
hint.clockworkdiver.dive.0: Inside the clock everything moves to the escapement's beat. Watch the pendulum at the top of the screen.
hint.clockworkdiver.dive.1: Strike as the pendulum crosses the centre jewel for a 'Just!' hit: more damage, combo and steam pressure.
hint.clockworkdiver.dive.2: Off-beat strikes break your combo and hit weaker. If things get dangerous, hold R to escape.
hint.clockworkdiver.rust.0: Rust clusters cover the seized gear. Smash them all with your wrench.
hint.clockworkdiver.rust.1: Hit a cluster with Just timing to shatter it in one blow!
hint.clockworkdiver.teeth.0: The escape wheel's teeth were stolen! The glowing cog gremlins carry them.
hint.clockworkdiver.teeth.1: Defeat them, pick up the teeth and right click the sockets at the back to fit them.
hint.clockworkdiver.screw.0: A giant screw came loose. Climb its thread like a spiral staircase.
hint.clockworkdiver.screw.1: On top, right click the slot with the wrench. Just turns drive it in; bad timing throws you off!
hint.clockworkdiver.spring.0: Right click the central crank with your wrench to wind the spring.
hint.clockworkdiver.spring.1: Enemies near the crank unwind it. Balance winding and defending.
hint.clockworkdiver.nest.0: The Time Eater's shell only cracks under Just Tick blows.
hint.clockworkdiver.nest.1: A ring of light on the floor warns of a time pulse. Piston Dash away!
hint.clockworkdiver.steam.0: Steam pressure is up! Right click the wrench for a Steam Burst that blasts enemies away.
hint.clockworkdiver.steam.1: Sneak + right click for a Piston Dash. Stand on a steam vent to refill steam.
hint.clockworkdiver.after.0: Tutorial complete! Now the story begins: townsfolk will bring clocks with secrets inside.
hint.clockworkdiver.after.1: Press J to open the Repair Journal: story progress and the keepsakes you received.
hint.clockworkdiver.after.2: Spend brass coins on tool upgrades in the bench's Upgrade tab. Repairs get harder as the story goes on.
title.clockworkdiver.boss.sub: Crack its shell with Just Ticks!
title.clockworkdiver.enraged.sub: The Time Eater quickened the beat
message.clockworkdiver.key_inside: Can't use that inside a clock. Hold R to escape
message.clockworkdiver.no_dimension: The Clockwork Diver dimensions are missing
message.clockworkdiver.build_failed: Could not build the clock interior
message.clockworkdiver.got_wrench: You picked up the Tinker's Wrench
message.clockworkdiver.screw_climb: Stand on the screw head before turning it
message.clockworkdiver.screw_close: Close! Turn it closer to the beat
message.clockworkdiver.screw_slip: Clang! Off beat - the screw threw you off!
message.clockworkdiver.aborted: You stopped the repair and left the clock
message.clockworkdiver.fainted: You fainted and were thrown out of the clock...
message.clockworkdiver.boss_shell: The shell is too hard! Attack with Just Ticks
message.clockworkdiver.steam_outside: Steam techniques only work inside a clock
message.clockworkdiver.got_glasses: You put on the Chrono Spectacles
message.clockworkdiver.not_your_customer: This customer seems to belong to another clockmaker
message.clockworkdiver.welcome: [Clockwork Diver] Open your clock repair workshop on a steampunk street!
message.clockworkdiver.welcome.key: Right click the Workshop Key in your inventory, or ->
message.clockworkdiver.welcome.hover: Click to travel to the clock repair workshop
command.clockworkdiver.status: Clocks repaired: %s / Reputation: %s / Wrench Lv.%s Steam Tank Lv.%s Lens Lv.%s
tooltip.clockworkdiver.clock.use: Right click: go to the repair bench
tooltip.clockworkdiver.clock.deliver: Give it back to the customer
tooltip.clockworkdiver.spectacles.0: At the repair bench, see inside clocks and spot faulty parts
tooltip.clockworkdiver.spectacles.1: Inside a clock, gremlins carrying teeth glow
tooltip.clockworkdiver.wrench.0: 'Just' strikes on the beat deal extra damage
tooltip.clockworkdiver.wrench.2: Sneak + right click: Piston Dash (25 steam)
tooltip.clockworkdiver.key.0: Right click: travel to your clock repair workshop / back
tooltip.clockworkdiver.key.1: The key to your shop on a steampunk street corner
gui.clockworkdiver.prompt.help: Press 'Repair Bench' to go to your bench and inspect the inside of the clock with the mysterious spectacles.
gui.clockworkdiver.prompt.done: The repair is finished. Give it back to the customer!
gui.clockworkdiver.no_job.help: Wait for customers in the workshop. Improve your tools in the Upgrade tab.
gui.clockworkdiver.done_help: Every part is repaired! Close the bench and give the clock back to the customer.
gui.clockworkdiver.find_help: Move the spectacle lens (your mouse) over the clock. Hold it over a part glowing red inside to identify it.
gui.clockworkdiver.select_help: Pick the part to repair and press 'Dive into this part'.
gui.clockworkdiver.banner.find: Move the lens to find the parts glowing red inside the clock
gui.clockworkdiver.banner.dive: Pick a part and press 'Dive into this part'!
gui.clockworkdiver.glasses_on: You put on the Chrono Spectacles
upgrade.clockworkdiver.2.desc: Wider Just timing window and a bigger spectacle lens
clock.clockworkdiver.music_box.desc: A music box clock with a twirling dancer. Its owner's memories live in the melody of its comb.
clock.clockworkdiver.grandfather.desc: A tall wooden case housing a long pendulum. It has kept a family's time for generations.
clock.clockworkdiver.great_clock.desc: The clock of the great tower at the heart of town. Every clock in town is bound to it by the time veins.
defect.clockworkdiver.dust.desc: Time Eater nesting dust clogs the gears. Dive in and blow the dust heaps away with Steam Bursts (right click). Dust moths carry dust back.
defect.clockworkdiver.tuning.desc: The chime comb is out of tune. Memorise the melody of the four tuning bells, then strike them back in the same order, on the beat (right click).
defect.clockworkdiver.clue.desc: Something strange is visible inside the clock.
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.dust: Blow the dust heaps away with Steam Bursts (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.tuning: Learn the bells' melody and strike it back on the beat (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.dive.fragments_: Repaired! Gather the remaining memory fragments (R to leave them)
objective.clockworkdiver.find_tower: At the tower gate, move the spectacle lens to find the faulty parts (%s/%s)
objective.clockworkdiver.talk_tower: Talk to your client in the clock tower plaza
objective.clockworkdiver.deliver_tower: Report to your client waiting in the plaza
title.clockworkdiver.boss.shadow.sub: It slips through the dark. Keep moving!
title.clockworkdiver.boss.shade.sub: A shard of the Queen is devouring a girl's memories
title.clockworkdiver.boss.queen.sub: Take back the Great Clock's time!
title.clockworkdiver.queen.2.sub: Keep up with the racing beat
title.clockworkdiver.queen.3.sub: Strike the off-beat. Trust the pendulum
message.clockworkdiver.time_up: Time's up...! You were thrown out of the clock
message.clockworkdiver.precision_screw: Precision slip! The screw backed out a turn
message.clockworkdiver.precision_tune: Precision slip! One finished melody fell apart
message.clockworkdiver.dust_back: The dust moths carried dust back!
message.clockworkdiver.dust_soft: It only stirs the dust. Blow it away with a Steam Burst (right click)
message.clockworkdiver.tune_play: Strike the same %s notes, on the beat!
message.clockworkdiver.gate_locked: The tower gate is firmly shut
message.clockworkdiver.gate_wait: The Great Clock creaks beyond the gate... wait for Pip's signal
message.clockworkdiver.gate_peace: The Great Clock keeps true time
message.clockworkdiver.customer_at_tower: %s is waiting in the plaza before the clock tower
hint.clockworkdiver.story.0: A story client has arrived! Every commission hides a surprising twist inside the clock.
hint.clockworkdiver.story.1: Select a part at the bench to see its twists (time limit, darkness...) before you dive.
hint.clockworkdiver.dust.0: Dust heaps won't break under the wrench. Use a Steam Burst (right click) to blow away all the dust around you.
hint.clockworkdiver.dust.1: Out of steam? Stand on a vent. Leave the dust moths alone and they will bring the dust back.
hint.clockworkdiver.tuning.0: The bells light up one by one to play a melody. Watch and listen closely.
hint.clockworkdiver.tuning.1: At the chime, right-click the bells with the wrench in the same order. Miss the beat or a note and the melody plays again.
hint.clockworkdiver.timed.0: This repair is timed! When the clock at the top of the screen reaches zero, you are thrown out.
hint.clockworkdiver.offbeat.0: An off-beat clock! Strike between the tick and the tock. The pendulum follows the off-beat, so trust your eyes.
hint.clockworkdiver.dark.0: This clock's lamps are out. Even in the dark, the spectacles outline your foes.
hint.clockworkdiver.precision.0: Precision work: missing the beat undoes a step of the repair. Take your time and aim for the heart of the beat.
hint.clockworkdiver.fragment.0: Glowing memory fragments lie around. Touch one to bring back its owner's memory. The repair ends once you have them all.
hint.clockworkdiver.clue.0: You found a glowing purple clue! Select it to read it. Clues don't need a dive.
hint.clockworkdiver.tower.0: Go through the archway across the street to reach the clock tower plaza.
hint.clockworkdiver.tower.1: The Great Clock is inspected at the tower gate. Right-click the gate or press the Repair Bench button.
hint.clockworkdiver.postgame.0: The story ends here, for now. Clients will keep bringing mysterious clocks to your workshop.
hint.clockworkdiver.postgame.1: You can watch the ending again from the Repair Journal (J).
dialogue.clockworkdiver.pip.offer.0: Clockmaker! It's Pip. Today I'm here as a customer!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.pip.offer.1: The clock in the tower lodge is cranky again... Could you take a look?
dialogue.clockworkdiver.pip.wait: Just watching you work is fun for me!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.pip.deliver: That sound... is it fixed already?!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.pip.thanks.0: Thank you! You really are amazing!
dialogue.clockworkdiver.pip.thanks.1: Someday I want to dive into a clock too...!
gui.clockworkdiver.journal.current: In progress. Hear the client out, repair the clock and deliver it.
command.clockworkdiver.story.done: The story is complete. Watch the ending from the Repair Journal.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.title: The Silent Whistle
story.clockworkdiver.q01.clock.desc: The steam-driven departure clock on the station platform. When it stops, every train in town stops with it.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.offer.0: bolt|Hey, clockmaker! Trouble! The station's departure clock has stopped!
story.clockworkdiver.q01.offer.1: bolt|Without it, not one train can leave. And tonight's last train carries medicine for the hospital in the next town.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.offer.2: me|(From deep inside the clock comes a faint gnawing sound...)
story.clockworkdiver.q01.offer.3: bolt|The engine crew said the same. Right before it stopped, something was moving inside. Gives me the creeps.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.offer.4: bolt|Please, fix it before the last train leaves! The regulator screw will be a race against the clock!
story.clockworkdiver.q01.wait: bolt|Is the last whistle blowing yet!? ...No. I'll wait. I trust you.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.deliver: bolt|Whoa, that sound... is it running?!
story.clockworkdiver.q01.thanks.0: narr|Toooot. In the distance, the last train's whistle rings out.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.thanks.1: bolt|Hear that? The last train! The medicine will make it. You're a hero!
story.clockworkdiver.q01.thanks.2: bolt|Say... was something like this wedged in the gears when you fixed it?
story.clockworkdiver.q01.thanks.3: narr|The black gear you pulled from the clock. It is slick, not with oil, but with something like the fat of a living thing.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.thanks.4: bolt|No maker's mark anywhere. ...You keep it. Let me know if you find out what it is.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.summary: You repaired the station's departure clock in time for the last train. Deep inside, you found an eerie black gear that seemed to pulse.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.keepsake.desc: A little brass whistle from Bolt.
story.clockworkdiver.q01.clue.desc: A black gear you have never seen before, bitten deep into the train. It seems to pulse, ever so faintly...
story.clockworkdiver.q02.title: Grandma's Lullaby
story.clockworkdiver.q02.clock.desc: A cuckoo clock her late grandmother made when the flower shop opened. On the hour it plays a lullaby... or it used to.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.offer.0: lily|Hello, clockmaker! I'm back. Today it's about this little one.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.offer.1: lily|Grandma made this cuckoo clock for me. Every morning it sang a lullaby with the cuckoo, but suddenly it went quiet.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.offer.2: lily|It's strange. I wound it, and the hands still move... but the song just vanished.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.offer.3: me|(Through the spectacles, specks of pale light deep inside the clock look as if something has been eating them...)
story.clockworkdiver.q02.offer.4: lily|Do clocks have memories too? Can you bring back Grandma's song?
story.clockworkdiver.q02.wait: lily|Is the cuckoo still asleep...? I'll wait right here.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.deliver: lily|Oh... I think I heard a tiny bit of the song just now!
story.clockworkdiver.q02.thanks.0: narr|Out pops the cuckoo, and an old lullaby fills the workshop.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.thanks.1: lily|...That's Grandma's voice. She always sang this to me when I was little...
story.clockworkdiver.q02.thanks.2: lily|Thank you, clockmaker. Clocks don't just count time, do they?
story.clockworkdiver.q02.thanks.3: me|(Clocks hold their owners' memories. And the Time Eaters feed on them...)
story.clockworkdiver.q02.thanks.4: lily|Oh, here. A bookmark made from Grandma's pressed flowers. Will you take it?
story.clockworkdiver.q02.summary: You brought back the lullaby that had vanished from Lily's cuckoo clock. Clocks hold their owners' memories inside them, and the Time Eaters, it seems, eat those memories.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.frag.0: The day the shop opened. Grandmother held little Lily's hand and hung the clock on the wall. "This one will wake you every morning."
story.clockworkdiver.q02.frag.1: A night of fever. Grandmother hums the lullaby at the bedside, and the cuckoo clock's music box softly joins in.
story.clockworkdiver.q02.frag.2: "Even when I'm gone, I'll leave the song right here." A gentle voice is engraved deep among the gears.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.title: Harmony of the Stars
story.clockworkdiver.q03.clock.desc: The astronomical clock in Celes's tower. Its four tuning bells announce the stars' courses in harmony.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.offer.0: celes|Thank you for seeing me, clockmaker. Celes. Today I come not to observe but to ask for a repair.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.offer.1: celes|My astronomical clock's bells have turned discordant. The harmony of the stars breaking is something that does not happen once in a century.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.offer.2: celes|And I have a troubling observation. Over the last seven days, every clock in town has fallen behind, all at once, by the smallest fraction.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.offer.3: celes|As if someone were eating the seconds out of our town, a little at a time.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.offer.4: me|(The black gear from Bolt's clock comes to mind...)
story.clockworkdiver.q03.offer.5: celes|Learn the melody of the tuning bells and strike it back in the same order. The stars are strict about the beat.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.wait: celes|The bells still sound muddy. Don't rush; listen to the melody.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.deliver: celes|...I can hear it. The four bells, joined in a single chord.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.thanks.0: celes|Splendid. The stars have not rung this clear since your master tuned them.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.thanks.1: celes|Before he disappeared, Elias told me: "If the town's clocks start to lag, watch the Great Clock."
story.clockworkdiver.q03.thanks.2: celes|Every clock in town is bound to the Great Clock tower by an unseen current we call the time vein. If something is happening, it is there.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.thanks.3: celes|Please take this fragment of a star chart. It will guide your way.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.summary: You tuned the bells of Celes's astronomical clock. Every clock in town is falling behind at once, and the breakdowns are someone's doing.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.keepsake.desc: Its brightest star points to the tower.
story.clockworkdiver.q03.clue.desc: The teeth of the hour wheel have been carefully filed down with a blade. This was no accident. Someone broke it on purpose.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.title: The Master's Pocket Watch
story.clockworkdiver.q04.clock.desc: The silver pocket watch Master Elias always carried. The workshop's crest is engraved inside the lid.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.offer.0: gregory|...Hello, clockmaker. I have not come as a customer today. I have come to keep a promise.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.offer.1: gregory|A year ago Elias left this with me. "If I'm not back within a year, give it to my apprentice," he said.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.offer.2: gregory|But this morning it stopped on its own. When I opened the lid, a black mist came seeping out...
story.clockworkdiver.q04.offer.3: me|(The spectacles reveal a huge shadow lurking inside the watch. A Time Eater.)
story.clockworkdiver.q04.offer.4: gregory|Perhaps he vanished because he knew something. The answer may lie inside this watch.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.wait: gregory|Be careful. That black mist is no ordinary rust.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.deliver: gregory|You're back! I'm glad you're safe... and the watch?
story.clockworkdiver.q04.thanks.0: gregory|Tick, tock... Elias's watch is keeping time again.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.thanks.1: me|(You tell him about the scraps of your master's notes you found inside.)
story.clockworkdiver.q04.thanks.2: gregory|What... "Time Eater eggs are being planted in the town's clocks"? And signed "E."... Is Elias alive...?
story.clockworkdiver.q04.thanks.3: gregory|This watch is yours now. And there was a tiny key hidden inside the lid. What it opens, even I cannot say.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.summary: You drove a Time Eater out of the pocket watch Elias had left with Old Gregory. Inside were scraps of your master's notes: the black gears are Time Eater eggs. Elias was chasing something.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.keepsake.desc: Hidden in the master's pocket watch.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.frag.0: (A scrap of notes) The black gears are Time Eater eggs. Someone is planting them in the town's clocks.
story.clockworkdiver.q04.frag.1: (A scrap of notes) Stay away from the Great Clock. If it wakes, the town's time will be devoured. - E.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.title: The Inventor and the Black Egg
story.clockworkdiver.q05.clock.desc: An automatic orrery Ada built herself. For some reason its planetary gears are buried in grey dust.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.offer.0: ada|There you are! Bolt told me about that black gear. Can I take a look?
story.clockworkdiver.q05.offer.1: ada|...Hmm, hmm. This isn't a part. It's hollow, and it pulses at a steady rhythm. Like an egg.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.offer.2: ada|So I set it next to my orrery as a test, and overnight the inside filled with dust! Time Eater nesting material, I bet.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.offer.3: ada|Blow the dust away with Steam Bursts. Watch out, moths will come pouring out of it!
story.clockworkdiver.q05.offer.4: ada|That settles it. The black gears are Time Eater eggs, and someone is putting them into clocks on purpose.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.wait: ada|Sorry, that was my experiment's fault... but what a discovery!
story.clockworkdiver.q05.deliver: ada|Not a speck of dust! That's the diving clockmaker for you!
story.clockworkdiver.q05.thanks.0: ada|Thanks! As a reward, here's my latest invention: a high-pressure steam tank!
story.clockworkdiver.q05.thanks.1: ada|Also, I heard a rumour. Night after night, a man in a grey coat has been prowling past people's windows.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.thanks.2: ada|He's probably the one planting the eggs. Be careful.
story.clockworkdiver.q05.summary: With Ada's help you learned that the black gears are Time Eater eggs. The one planting them seems to be a man in a grey coat.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.title: The Phantom's Calling Card
story.clockworkdiver.q06.clock.desc: The birdcage clock of Countess Rose, the jewel of high society. The Phantom stole it last night.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.offer.0: phantom|Once again I come as a customer. ...Though this clock, I confess, is stolen.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.offer.1: me|(For a moment you wonder whether to call the constables...)
story.clockworkdiver.q06.offer.2: phantom|Do not misunderstand. I steal only clocks that carry eggs, to take them away from their owners before they hatch.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.offer.3: phantom|This birdcage clock had one too. It must be repaired and returned before dawn, before the Countess notices.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.offer.4: phantom|The cog gremlins inside are fiercer than usual, it seems. Please hurry, clockmaker.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.wait: phantom|Dawn draws near. ...But you will make it.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.thanks.0: phantom|Now the Countess will wake to birdsong again. I shall slip it back onto her windowsill.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.thanks.1: phantom|A word of warning. I have seen the man who plants the eggs. A grey coat, and eyes swollen as if from weeping.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.thanks.2: phantom|He did not have a villain's face. That is what makes him dangerous.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.thanks.3: phantom|A token of thanks. If you walk the streets at night, a black feather will keep you safe.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.summary: You repaired the birdcage clock the Phantom had stolen before dawn. He steals egg-laden clocks to protect people, and he has seen the man in the grey coat.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.keepsake.desc: It came with the Phantom's calling card.
story.clockworkdiver.q06.clue.desc: Grey wool tangled in the gears. It looks like fine coat cloth.
story.clockworkdiver.q07.title: Pip the Bell-Ringer's Request
story.clockworkdiver.q07.clock.desc: A tall slave clock in the Great Clock tower's lodge. Linked to the Great Clock by the time vein, it mirrors its heartbeat.
story.clockworkdiver.q07.offer.0: pip|Um, excuse me! Are you the clockmaker? I'm Pip, apprentice bell-ringer of the Great Clock tower!
story.clockworkdiver.q07.offer.1: pip|The slave clock in the tower lodge suddenly started racing like an alarm bell... and it won't stop!
story.clockworkdiver.q07.offer.2: pip|The slave clock mirrors the Great Clock's heartbeat. So... maybe something is thrashing around inside the Great Clock.
story.clockworkdiver.q07.offer.3: pip|The old tower keeper just keeps saying "Never open the Great Clock's door." Please, at least fix the slave clock!
story.clockworkdiver.q07.offer.4: pip|Oh, and be careful. The beat in there is really, really fast!
story.clockworkdiver.q07.wait: pip|The slave clock is still pounding... Is the Great Clock going to be okay...
story.clockworkdiver.q07.deliver: pip|The heartbeat... it's slowing down! You fixed it!
story.clockworkdiver.q07.thanks.0: pip|Thank you so much! Now I can ring tonight's bells properly.
story.clockworkdiver.q07.thanks.1: me|(You show Pip the scrap of paper you found inside the slave clock.)
story.clockworkdiver.q07.thanks.2: pip|"The Queen is stirring"...? What queen...? That's kind of scary.
story.clockworkdiver.q07.thanks.3: pip|I'll keep watch on the tower! If anything happens, I'll tell you right away!
story.clockworkdiver.q07.summary: At Pip the bell-ringer's request, you repaired the racing slave clock of the Great Clock tower. Inside was another of your master's notes: the Queen is stirring. Something is growing inside the Great Clock.
story.clockworkdiver.q07.frag.0: (Notes) The Queen is stirring. Through the time veins she drinks time from every egg in town. - E.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.title: The Grey Man
story.clockworkdiver.q08.clock.desc: The heart of Bolt's beloved locomotive, the Brass Comet: the governor clock that sets its pace.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.offer.0: bolt|Clockmaker! I saw him, the man in the grey coat! In the engine shed, putting something into my Brass Comet!
story.clockworkdiver.q08.offer.1: bolt|I chased him, but he vanished like smoke. All he left was this scrap of paper.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.offer.2: narr|On the paper is a sigil: a gear biting its own tail.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.offer.3: bolt|There's a growl coming from the governor, like a starving beast. ...Please, save my partner.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.offer.4: bolt|I don't think that's an ordinary Time Eater in there. Its shell was pitch black.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.wait: bolt|Let me hear my partner's whistle again... I'm counting on you.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.deliver: bolt|H-hey... I can hear my partner's boiler again!
story.clockworkdiver.q08.thanks.0: bolt|The Brass Comet is back to full steam! I owe you for life.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.thanks.1: bolt|I showed that sigil to an old engineer friend and he went pale. "That's the mark of a clockmaker who left town after the Great Steam Fire ten years ago," he said.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.thanks.2: bolt|The fire ten years ago... a lot of people lost what mattered most to them.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.thanks.3: bolt|Here, one of my partner's spare gears. Keep it as a good-luck charm.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.summary: You defeated the black-shelled Time Eater planted in Bolt's locomotive. The sigil the grey man left behind is the mark of a clockmaker who left town after the Great Steam Fire ten years ago.
story.clockworkdiver.q08.clue.desc: A gear forming a ring like a snake biting its own tail. It is engraved inside the governor too.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.title: The Spiralling Star Chart
story.clockworkdiver.q09.clock.desc: The great orrery of the Royal Observatory. Celes keeps the lights out to chart how the town's clocks are lagging.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.offer.0: celes|I have been waiting for you. There is something I must show you.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.offer.1: celes|I marked every egg-laden clock on a star chart. They form a spiral, and it leads to the Great Clock tower.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.offer.2: celes|But halfway through, the orrery itself stopped. For the observations, every light in the tower is out.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.offer.3: celes|Even in darkness, the spectacles should show you the outlines of your foes. ...Please, take care.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.wait: celes|The heart of the spiral... it is the Great Clock tower, without a doubt.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.deliver: celes|The orrery's planets have begun to turn again.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.thanks.0: celes|Thank you. And... did you find anything inside?
story.clockworkdiver.q09.thanks.1: me|(You show her the notes you found inside the orrery.)
story.clockworkdiver.q09.thanks.2: celes|"I am inside the Great Clock"... Elias is inside the Great Clock? For a whole year?
story.clockworkdiver.q09.thanks.3: celes|They say time flows differently inside a clock. For him, it may have been only a single night.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.thanks.4: celes|Take this lens, the observatory's treasure, made to gather starlight. It should fit your spectacles.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.summary: Celes's star chart revealed a spiral leading to the Great Clock tower. In the notes inside the orrery, your master had written: I am inside the Great Clock.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.frag.0: (Notes) If these words reach you, my apprentice: I am inside the Great Clock, holding back the waking Queen.
story.clockworkdiver.q09.frag.1: (Notes) Time runs slowly in here. For me it has been but a night. How long has it been out there? Is everyone well? - E.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.title: The Music Box Girl
story.clockworkdiver.q10.clock.desc: A music box clock with a tiny dancing figurine. Its base bears what look like scorch marks.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.offer.0: stranger|...So this is the shop of the clockmaker who dives into clocks.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.offer.1: stranger|My daughter's music box. It has not played in years. ...Or perhaps I simply could not bear to play it.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.offer.2: stranger|She used to dance to it. If I could see that, just once more...
story.clockworkdiver.q10.offer.3: me|(The man keeps his grey collar up and his face down. Through the spectacles, the hem of his coat seems to stir with a faint black mist.)
story.clockworkdiver.q10.wait: stranger|...There is no hurry. I have waited ten years.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.thanks.0: narr|The music box begins to play. The little dancer twirls round and round.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.thanks.2: stranger|Thank you, clockmaker. ...Your master has a fine apprentice.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.thanks.3: narr|He bows deeply and disappears into the dusk, the hem of his grey coat swirling behind him.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.thanks.4: me|(A grey coat... Could he be...?)
story.clockworkdiver.q10.summary: A grey gentleman who would not give his name brought in the music box clock of his late daughter, Mira. Inside were memories of the Great Steam Fire ten years ago. The base was engraved "V.G."
story.clockworkdiver.q10.keepsake.desc: The gentleman asked you to keep it.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.frag.0: (Memory) "Papa, look!" A little girl twirls to the music box.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.frag.1: (Memory) "Happy birthday, Mira." Her father hands her a music box clock he made himself.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.frag.2: (Memory) The sky outside the workshop window is red. Steam pipes burst. Someone is screaming.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.frag.3: (Memory) In the flames, only the music box played on. "Papa..." There the memory breaks off.
story.clockworkdiver.q10.clue.desc: It reads: "To my dear Mira. With love, Papa. V.G."
story.clockworkdiver.q11.title: The Phantom's Confession
story.clockworkdiver.q11.clock.desc: A clockwork key that opens the Great Clock tower's inspection door. Master Elias entrusted it to the Phantom.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.offer.0: phantom|Tonight it is not stolen goods. I have brought a clock of my own.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.offer.1: phantom|I shall confess. I was once a pupil of Master Elias. A failure who could only use his nimble fingers for theft.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.offer.2: phantom|A year ago he gave me this key watch. "Once I go into the Great Clock, let no one open the door," he said.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.offer.3: phantom|Last night the grey man came to take it. I kept it, barely... but he planted an egg in it.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.offer.4: phantom|His name is Viktor Grau. The master's other apprentice, a man who lost his daughter in the fire ten years ago.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.offer.5: phantom|Before the Time Eater inside fully hatches. There's no time. Please!
story.clockworkdiver.q11.wait: phantom|...Viktor. What are you trying to do...
story.clockworkdiver.q11.thanks.0: phantom|Thank you. The Great Clock's door is still guarded.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.thanks.1: phantom|Viktor lost his daughter Mira in the fire. Ever since, he has searched for nothing but a way to turn back time.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.thanks.2: me|(Mira... the owner of that music box. Then the grey gentleman was...)
story.clockworkdiver.q11.thanks.3: phantom|You see it now. The music box you repaired belonged to Viktor's daughter.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.thanks.4: phantom|Whatever he is plotting, it surely involves the Queen in the Great Clock. As thanks, these gloves. They will serve you well.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.summary: The Phantom was once your master's pupil. The grey man is Viktor Grau, the master's other apprentice, who lost his daughter Mira in the Great Steam Fire. He was the father of the music box's owner.
story.clockworkdiver.q11.keepsake.desc: The wrench feels right in hand.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.title: Follow the Time Veins
story.clockworkdiver.q12.clock.desc: A detector of Ada's own design that maps the time veins like a star chart. It runs on the off-beat.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.offer.0: ada|It's done: the Time Eater detector, Tokikagami! You can actually see the time veins flow!
story.clockworkdiver.q12.offer.1: ada|...Except the moment I switched it on, the eggs' signal threw everything out of whack.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.offer.2: ada|Oh, and careful! Tokikagami runs on the off-beat. Strike in the gap between the tick and the tock.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.offer.3: ada|The pendulum is set to the off-beat, so trust your eyes, not your ears!
story.clockworkdiver.q12.wait: ada|Off-beat, off-beat! Aim for the gap between tick and tock!
story.clockworkdiver.q12.deliver: ada|Tokikagami's needle... it moved! Look, it's showing the time veins!
story.clockworkdiver.q12.thanks.0: ada|Every time vein in town is being sucked toward the Great Clock tower... So this is how the Queen feeds.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.thanks.1: ada|And I traced where the eggs' signal comes from: an abandoned workshop on the edge of town, burned ten years ago. It belonged to a clockmaker named Viktor.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.thanks.2: me|(You read Ada the notes you found inside the detector.)
story.clockworkdiver.q12.thanks.3: ada|...That's so sad. But we have to stop him, before the town's time is eaten away entirely.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.summary: Ada's Tokikagami showed the town's time veins draining into the Great Clock tower. The eggs come from Viktor's burned-out workshop. Your master's note pleaded: do not blame Viktor.
story.clockworkdiver.q12.frag.0: (Notes) Do not blame Viktor. He only wants his daughter back. The Queen preyed on that wish. - E.
story.clockworkdiver.q13.title: The Stopping Town
story.clockworkdiver.q13.clock.desc: The slave clock Pip watches over. Each time the Great Clock's heart falters, its pendulum jerks in pain.
story.clockworkdiver.q13.offer.0: pip|Clockmaker, it's terrible! The Great Clock's bells are ringing at all the wrong times!
story.clockworkdiver.q13.offer.1: pip|The trains are stuck at the station, the fountain water freezes in midair and then falls... It's like the whole town is stumbling.
story.clockworkdiver.q13.offer.2: pip|The slave clock can't hold out much longer. If it stops, nothing will hold the Great Clock back!
story.clockworkdiver.q13.offer.3: pip|The beat is even faster than last time. And there's no time. Hurry, but stay calm...!
story.clockworkdiver.q13.deliver: pip|The slave clock's pendulum... it's steady again!
story.clockworkdiver.q13.thanks.0: pip|Thank goodness... That should keep the Great Clock in check for a while.
story.clockworkdiver.q13.thanks.1: pip|The old tower keeper said, "Elias is holding the Queen back inside the Great Clock. But he can't last much longer."
story.clockworkdiver.q13.thanks.2: pip|Your master must be amazing. Someday I want to be like you, clockmaker.
story.clockworkdiver.q13.summary: The Great Clock's frenzy has set the town's time stumbling. With Pip you steadied the slave clock and barely held the Great Clock in check. But your master cannot hold on much longer.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.title: The Flower That Never Wilts
story.clockworkdiver.q14.clock.desc: The sign clock of Lily's flower shop. Inside the birdcage, glass flowers tell the hours.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.offer.0: lily|Clockmaker... the flowers in my shop bloom, then wilt in an instant, then bloom again... over and over.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.offer.1: lily|So I looked at the shop's sign clock, and there was a black gear inside. ...Yesterday evening, a grey man was standing in front of the shop.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.offer.2: lily|He kept staring at the flowers outside... and he was crying. "My daughter loved these," he said.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.offer.3: lily|Is he a bad person...? I don't know. But I want to save my shop's clock. Please, clockmaker!
story.clockworkdiver.q14.wait: lily|The flowers are trying so hard to bloom.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.deliver: lily|Oh, the flowers... they're staying in bloom!
story.clockworkdiver.q14.thanks.0: lily|Thank you! Now the flowers can take their time blooming.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.thanks.1: lily|Hey, clockmaker. That grey man... if you see him, will you tell him something?
story.clockworkdiver.q14.thanks.2: lily|"Flowers are beautiful because they wilt." Grandma always used to say that.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.thanks.3: lily|Here, a glass flower. It will never wilt. ...That's a little bit of cheating, though.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.summary: You drove the Time Eater out of Lily's shop sign clock. The grey man had wept at the flowers his late daughter loved. Lily asked you to give him a message: flowers are beautiful because they wilt.
story.clockworkdiver.q14.keepsake.desc: A little cheat: it never wilts.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.title: The Diary in the Backwards Clock
story.clockworkdiver.q15.clock.desc: A cuckoo clock carried out of the burned workshop. Its hands turn backwards, and the cuckoo flies back into the clock.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.offer.0: phantom|I slipped into Viktor's abandoned workshop. ...He was out, but he left this behind.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.offer.1: phantom|A cuckoo clock that keeps time backwards. It seems he used it to study turning back time.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.offer.2: ada|I came too! The Phantom called me. According to Tokikagami, this clock is wired straight into the Great Clock through the time veins!
story.clockworkdiver.q15.offer.3: phantom|I sense his diary is hidden inside. But it is a nasty contraption that runs on the off-beat.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.offer.4: ada|If we read the diary, we'll know Viktor's plan. Don't forget the off-beat!
story.clockworkdiver.q15.wait: phantom|...Reading his diary sits ill with me, but we have no choice.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.thanks.0: me|(You read them the diary pages you found inside the clock.)
story.clockworkdiver.q15.thanks.1: phantom|..."The Queen promised: devour the Great Clock and time will rewind ten years."
story.clockworkdiver.q15.thanks.2: ada|That's impossible! A town whose time is eaten doesn't rewind. It just stops... forever!
story.clockworkdiver.q15.thanks.3: phantom|The Queen has deceived him. ...But can words stop a man who believes he can get his daughter back?
story.clockworkdiver.q15.thanks.4: phantom|He will act the next time the Great Clock's bells go wrong. ...Clockmaker, are you ready?
story.clockworkdiver.q15.summary: The Phantom carried a backwards cuckoo clock out of Viktor's workshop. The diary inside recorded the Queen's promise: devour the Great Clock and time will rewind ten years. Viktor has been deceived.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.keepsake.desc: Viktor's doubt shows in the ink.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.frag.0: (Diary) Without Mira the workshop is as silent as if time had stopped. If only it really would.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.frag.1: (Diary) A voice spoke from deep within the Great Clock: "Do you wish to go back ten years?" The Queen knew my wish.
story.clockworkdiver.q15.frag.2: (Diary) If I sow the eggs across the town, the Queen will devour the Great Clock, and time will rewind. Wait for me, Mira.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.title: A Father's Resolve
story.clockworkdiver.q16.clock.desc: The music box clock of Viktor's daughter, Mira. It is shrouded in black mist again, and the Queen's presence hangs over it.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.offer.0: viktor|...We meet again, clockmaker. Let me introduce myself properly. I am Viktor Grau, the man who sowed the eggs across this town.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.offer.1: viktor|Tonight I open the Great Clock's door. When the Queen devours it, time will return to ten years ago, to the days when Mira was alive.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.offer.2: viktor|...But my daughter's music box has fallen silent again. The Queen's shade has reached even this.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.offer.3: viktor|I know how selfish this is. Let me hear Mira's song one last time. Then I will go.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.offer.4: me|(Should you stop him? But first you must see what lies inside this clock...)
story.clockworkdiver.q16.wait: viktor|...I am sorry. This is all I have left.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.thanks.0: narr|Mixed with the music box's melody, a little girl's voice flows out.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.thanks.1: note|"Papa, time doesn't need to go back. As long as you remember, I'll always be by your side."
story.clockworkdiver.q16.thanks.3: me|(You pass on Lily's message: "Flowers are beautiful because they wilt.")
story.clockworkdiver.q16.thanks.4: viktor|...What have I done. Turning back time was never what my daughter wanted.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.thanks.5: viktor|But it is too late. I broke the door's seal last night. The Queen is already waking.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.thanks.6: viktor|Take this. The key to the Great Clock tower. Master Elias is inside. ...Please, stop what I have started.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.summary: Viktor named himself and asked you to repair his daughter's music box. Mira's last words, asleep inside it, moved his heart. But the seal is already broken and the Queen is waking. Viktor gave you the key to the Great Clock tower.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.keepsake: Key to the Great Clock Tower
story.clockworkdiver.q16.frag.0: (Memory) In the ruins, the father wept, clutching the music box. A little girl's spirit watched him all along.
story.clockworkdiver.q16.frag.1: (Memory) At the very end, Mira tucked a message for her father deep inside the music box.
story.clockworkdiver.q17.title: To the Great Clock Tower
story.clockworkdiver.q17.clock: The Great Clock of Gearhaven: Outer Train
story.clockworkdiver.q17.clock.desc: The Great Clock that governs the town's time. Its vast outer train is being gnawed apart by the Queen's brood.
story.clockworkdiver.q17.offer.0: pip|Clockmaker! We've been waiting. Everyone's here!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.offer.1: bolt|Hey! The trains are still stuck, but my engineer's gut says tonight's the night!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.offer.2: ada|Tokikagami says the Great Clock's outer train is in tatters. It's swarming with the Queen's brood.
story.clockworkdiver.q17.offer.3: phantom|The door is open. ...Beyond it lies a place only you can go.
story.clockworkdiver.q17.offer.4: pip|Put on your spectacles in front of the tower gate. You should be able to see inside the Great Clock!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.offer.5: me|(With the key Viktor entrusted to you, you unlock the tower gate...)
story.clockworkdiver.q17.wait: pip|We'll all be waiting right here! Be careful!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.deliver: pip|The outer gears... I can hear them again!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.thanks.0: pip|Amazing! The outside of the Great Clock sounds right again!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.thanks.1: celes|The stars and the Great Clock's beat are slowly coming back into step. But its heart is still...
story.clockworkdiver.q17.thanks.2: note|(A faint voice from beyond the gate) "...Is that you, my apprentice? Well done. But it is not over. The heart is being eaten."
story.clockworkdiver.q17.thanks.3: pip|That voice...! That was your master, wasn't it?!
story.clockworkdiver.q17.summary: Seen off by your friends, you opened the tower gate. You drove back the brood devouring the outer train and heard your master's voice beyond the gate.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.title: The Heart of the Great Clock
story.clockworkdiver.q18.clock: The Great Clock of Gearhaven: The Heart
story.clockworkdiver.q18.clock.desc: The Great Clock's heart: a giant mainspring and its tuning bells. If it stops, the town's heartbeat stops too.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.offer.0: pip|I heard your master's voice again! "Protect the heart," he said!
story.clockworkdiver.q18.offer.1: viktor|...I came too. I know I have no right. But no one knows the Great Clock's workings better than I do.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.offer.2: viktor|The heart's tuning bells are the town's very heartbeat. With the beat in disarray, the melody runs fast.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.offer.3: viktor|The mainspring lies deep in darkness. The Queen's shade is eating the light. ...I am sorry. All of this is my fault.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.offer.4: lily|Mister! ...Grandma used to say flowers are beautiful because they wilt. So it's not too late, even now!
story.clockworkdiver.q18.deliver: viktor|The heartbeat... it's back. The Great Clock's heart is beating again!
story.clockworkdiver.q18.thanks.0: viktor|Remarkable. I see why Master Elias entrusted you with his spectacles.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.thanks.1: note|"Well done, my apprentice. The Queen is cornered now. But in the end she will flee into the escapement."
story.clockworkdiver.q18.thanks.2: viktor|The escapement, the very thing that keeps the Great Clock's time. The Queen means to nest there and devour time itself.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.thanks.3: viktor|I will hold the mainspring from outside so she cannot escape. ...Go, clockmaker.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.summary: With Viktor's help you repaired the Great Clock's heart. Your master's voice warned that in the end the Queen will flee into the escapement, the very thing that keeps time.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.keepsake.desc: It hums with the town's heartbeat.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.frag.0: (Master's voice) Can you hear me, my apprentice? The heart's bells sing the same song as every clock in town.
story.clockworkdiver.q18.frag.1: (Master's voice) The clocks you have mended are giving their strength back to the Great Clock now. Not one repair was in vain.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.title: The Queen of Time Eaters
story.clockworkdiver.q19.clock: The Great Clock of Gearhaven: The Escapement
story.clockworkdiver.q19.clock.desc: The great escapement that keeps time. The Queen has nested here and goes on devouring the town's time.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.offer.0: pip|Clockmaker... this is it, isn't it.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.offer.1: celes|The Queen has moved into the escapement. She will bend the beat as she pleases: faster, and then turned inside out.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.offer.2: ada|Her shell is many times harder than an ordinary Time Eater's. Chain your Just Ticks and hammer her with Steam Bursts!
story.clockworkdiver.q19.offer.3: phantom|When you return, I shall brew you the finest tea. ...So do return.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.offer.4: gregory|Our town's time is in your hands. Come back, and bring Elias with you.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.offer.5: me|(You take a deep breath and put on your spectacles...)
story.clockworkdiver.q19.deliver: pip|The bells... they rang at the right time! Clockmaker, you did it!!
story.clockworkdiver.q19.thanks.0: narr|The Great Clock's bells toll the true hour. Every clock in town begins to beat as one.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.thanks.1: narr|Stalled trains whistle, and the fountain water hanging in midair falls, sparkling.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.thanks.2: elias|...Phew. I thought it was one night, but out here it has been a year. Sorry to keep you waiting, my apprentice.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.thanks.3: elias|Look at you. And it is not only your skill that has grown.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.thanks.5: elias|We can talk at the workshop, Viktor. First, let us all go home. ...To our workshop.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.summary: You defeated the Queen of Time Eaters nesting in the great escapement. The town's time runs true again, and Master Elias returned from the Great Clock after a year.
story.clockworkdiver.q19.keepsake.desc: It will never eat time again.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.title: Heir of Time
story.clockworkdiver.q20.clock.desc: The grandfather clock Master Elias built the day he opened the workshop. He vowed to adjust it once more on the day his apprentice came of age.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.offer.0: elias|Now then, my apprentice. One last commission. The customer is... me.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.offer.1: elias|I built this grandfather clock the day I opened the workshop. I vowed to adjust it once more on the day my apprentice came of age.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.offer.2: elias|Today is that day. A repairer's final exam: precision work. Miss the beat, and the work is undone.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.offer.3: gregory|Ho ho, Elias's exams are strict. I watched one in my youth and broke into a cold sweat.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.offer.4: elias|Do not worry. You have already listened to the voices of every clock in town.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.wait: elias|Don't rush. Listen to the clock's voice. That is the only thing I can teach you.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.deliver: elias|...Well then, let me hear it.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.0: narr|The grandfather clock strikes the hour, deep and clear. Everyone gathered in the workshop listens in silence.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.1: elias|...Splendid. You pass. In fact, it sounds better than when I made it.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.2: elias|From today, this is your workshop. And the Chrono Spectacles are truly yours.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.3: viktor|Master Elias, I will leave town and journey to make amends. I will rebuild my workshop so that one day I can make clocks that help people.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.4: elias|Yes. When that day comes, I will welcome you back as my apprentice. ...Mira would want that too.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.5: lily|Mister, come by the flower shop too! I'll have the prettiest flowers ready!
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.6: bolt|All right, let's celebrate by running the trains all night long!
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.7: ada|I wonder what kind of clock will come next. I already have an idea for a new invention!
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.8: phantom|As for me... well. Now and then I shall bring a clock that is not stolen.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.9: celes|The stars are celebrating too. Tonight's sky will be something special.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.10: pip|Clockmaker! Please make me your apprentice! ...Oh, um, someday is fine!
story.clockworkdiver.q20.thanks.11: elias|Ha ha ha. Now, master of the workshop. Your next customer is already waiting at the door.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.summary: You passed Master Elias's final exam, the precision adjustment of the workshop's grandfather clock. You formally inherited the workshop and became Gearhaven's Heir of Time.
story.clockworkdiver.q20.keepsake: Badge of the Heir of Time
story.clockworkdiver.q20.frag.0: (Memory) A young Elias fits the last gear into the clock. "May an apprentice come someday to whom I can entrust this clock."
story.clockworkdiver.q20.frag.1: (Memory) A night a year ago. Elias left the Chrono Spectacles by his sleeping apprentice's pillow and slipped out. "Forgive me. But you will be all right."
story.clockworkdiver.q20.frag.2: (Memory) The grandfather clock saw it all: the apprentice who kept mending clocks alone in a workshop without its master.
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.1: Chapter I: The Rookie of Gearhaven
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.1.summary: A year has passed since Master Elias vanished. You run his workshop now, mending the town's clocks with his Chrono Spectacles. But deep inside them, strange black gears have begun to turn up, gears that seem to pulse.
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.2.summary: The black gears are Time Eater eggs. With Ada the inventor and the Phantom thief, you follow the trail, and a man in a grey coat who plants eggs by night begins to take shape.
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.3.sub: ~ A Voice in the Great Clock ~
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.3.summary: The grey man's sigil, the Great Steam Fire of ten years ago, and notes left by your master inside the clocks. The dots begin to connect. Elias may still be out there, fighting the Time Eaters.
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.4: Chapter IV: The Great Clock Goes Mad
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.4.summary: As the Queen stirs, the Great Clock's heartbeat falters. Trains stall, flowers bloom and wilt in an instant. And Viktor, the grey clockmaker, finally knocks on your door himself.
story.clockworkdiver.chapter.5.summary: The tower gate stands open. Within, Master Elias has held the Queen at bay for a year. With your friends at your back, you set out on your final repair.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.bolt: bolt|The trains are still silent... but I'm not moving from here until you're back!
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.ada: ada|I'm watching the inside with Tokikagami. The brood is enormous... but you'll be fine!
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.phantom: phantom|Leave the door to me. Tonight no one will trouble this tower.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.celes: celes|I am comparing the Great Clock's beat with the stars. Little by little, they are coming into step.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.lily: lily|I brought flowers for everyone. When you come back, I'll give you the biggest bouquet!
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.gregory: gregory|That Elias, keeping us waiting a whole year. ...When he's back, I'll give him a piece of my mind.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.tower.viktor: viktor|...I am the one who opened this door. At least let me wait here for your return.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.gregor: gregory|Ho ho, this is the second time I've watched one of Elias's exams. My old heart can hardly take it.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.pip: pip|I'm going to watch your hands very carefully and learn!
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.bolt: bolt|The trains are ready to run all night. All we need now is for you to pass!
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.ada: ada|Can I peek inside the grandfather clock with Tokikagami? ...No? It'd disturb the precision work? Aww.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.lily: lily|I brought lots of flowers to celebrate! The workshop might turn into a flower garden.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.celes: celes|Tonight I shall name a new star. ...Look forward to hearing what I call it.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.phanto: phantom|The tea is ready. The finest, as promised.
story.clockworkdiver.scene.finale.viktor: viktor|...I leave town tomorrow. Before I go, I wanted to see your work.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.5: Bolt's trains run through town right on time, every day.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.6: In front of Lily's shop, the flowers of each season bloom and fall.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.7: Celes named a new star after a little workshop.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.8: Ada's flying clock crashed through a roof on its third test flight.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.9: These days, they say, the Phantom's calling cards arrive with a "Repaired" tag attached.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.10: Every day, Pip rings the Great Clock's bells at exactly the right time.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.11: Viktor rebuilt a small workshop on the ruins, where he teaches children to make music boxes.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.12: Old Gregory still opens the workshop door each day as its oldest customer.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.13: And Elias... now and then he wanders into the workshop and smiles fondly at his apprentice's work.
story.clockworkdiver.ending.15: The clocks of Gearhaven keep time today, as always,
story.clockworkdiver.ending.16: in the hands of the Heir of Time.

story.clockworkdiver.ending.44: And to you, for playing all the way here.
